name: META5M Wallet API
description:
REST API for META5M wallet management, blockchain operations, and gasless payments.

This API provides endpoints for:
- Wallet creation and management
- Native cryptocurrency transfers
- ERC-20 token operations
- Smart contract interactions
- EIP-712 typed data signing
- Gasless payment flows

## Authentication
All endpoints (except wallet creation) require JWT authentication. Include the token in the Authorization header:
```
Authorization: Bearer <your-jwt-token>
```

## Base URL
Production: `https://wallet.meta5m.com`
